source: Original user-proposed palettes plus distinct design proposals for repeated color groups; these are not official corporation colors.

distinct_palette.reason: Light blue and navy follow the maritime logo and separate Arklight from Morning Star.
A steel center with an orange frame gives Astrodrill an industrial look.
Dark orange suggests mineral ore, with a cool steel frame.
Dark yellow and steel distinguish Palladin from Helion’s yellow and black.
Green takes the center, using the green in the original alternatives and keeping an orange frame.
A white center and navy frame echo the moon logo and reverse the original pair.
Gold complements the orange emblem while purple gives Pristar a distinct frame.
Navy keeps the night-sky theme; a gold frame gives Saturn a warm ring.
The orange logo stands against a black center, surrounded by a bright orange frame.
Bright orange keeps Teractor’s identity and separates it from Mining Guild’s darker palette.
A blue frame uses the previously suggested accent and separates Tycho from Pharmacy Union.
Coral gives Vitor a warmer pink-orange identity while retaining its white frame.
